rubrics.justification: The response conflicts with the provided lab grading of 0DD by calling the embryo a fair-to-good day-4 morula/very early cavitating embryo and stating Gardner scoring is not applicable. It under-recognizes the very poor/degenerative ICM and TE implied by 0DD.

It integrates age, prior live birth, ovarian response, endometrium, male factor, lifestyle, and untested status well, though AMH is unavailable and the interaction with the very poor embryo grade is somewhat softened.

The structure is logical, but the prognosis is built on a more favorable morphology assessment than the case data support, making the implantation estimate somewhat inconsistent with the stated 0DD grade.

General recommendations are mostly guideline-consistent, but dismissing Gardner grading despite the supplied 0DD score and framing the embryo as fair-good rather than poor quality is not well aligned with standard blastocyst assessment conventions.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management, embryo number caution, continued culture, PGT-A discussion, ICSI review, and possible sperm DNA fragmentation testing, though recommendations are based on an overly optimistic morphology read.
